briefing.headline: Soft landing holds as inflation edges higher but growth remains resilient.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.56 percent for Sep 2026 sits above the Fed's target, keeping borrowing costs steady.
Unemployment at 4.2 percent for Sep 2026 holds employment firm enough to absorb the pressure.

briefing.whats_new: Today: US Dollar index softer, from 121.4048 to 121.3202.
